extract_read_writes: extract read and write memory dependencies from a function given tensor shapes and symbolic index expressions
merge_read_writes: merge multiple ReadWrites objects to combine their reads, writes, and index expressions into a single dependency set
check_memory_dep_contiguous: check whether a MemoryDep uses contiguous indexing by verifying the index is a single variable from its dimension set
check_memory_dep_scalar: check whether a MemoryDep represents a scalar access rather than a tensor element access
check_memory_dep_indirect: check whether a MemoryDep uses indirect indexing by detecting indirect or tmp symbols in the index expression
